package.name: amr_hri
package.description: RViz2 panel plugin "AMR Console" — goal pose entry, E-STOP toggle, and nav-state status label. HRI deliverable that replaces the tkinter GUI. Subscribes to NavigateToGoal action feedback for live state display; publishes /goal_pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped) and /cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/Twist, zeroed) on E-STOP.
